changes: Updated Ancestry journey data with the latest journey sets for Ashkenazi Jewish, Balkan, Croatian, Italian, and Maltese communities. New journeys include Romania, Ionian Islands, Serbia, Sardinia, Apulia, and Malta.
Refreshed journey and subjourney names used by filtering, the map view, and shared stats.
Fixed the Ancestry region, journey, and subjourney search in Filtering Options so matching entries actually appear in the dropdown when it opens.
Ancestry region filters can now exclude a region: set the maximum to 0 (for example 0–0) to show only matches that do NOT have that region. It still combines with every other filter.
Added a Hide limited data filter for matches where Ancestry only shows the regions and journeys you have in common. It is off by default.
Added a Map view to the Ancestry match list: see where the selected profile's matches' journeys are, with a color for each journey and match counts right on the map.
Click a journey to explore its subjourneys, then switch to List to see that journey's matches. By default only matches with a single journey are counted.
MatchFetch now finds your open Ancestry or 23andMe tab, including Ancestry's redirected matches page, and opens it in the background if it's missing.
Clearer login and error messages with icons, a link to the required page, and a reminder to refresh MatchFetch. 23andMe now asks you to log in instead of showing a connection error.
Share now clears shared stats for profiles that have no local data for the version being shared.
The share confirmation now lists the profiles whose shared stats will be cleared.
Improved journey sharing: journeys with matches spread across multiple profiles are no longer dropped before the 20-match minimum is applied.
If you've shared your journey stats before, use Share again to update your contribution.
Subjourney names are now up to date with Ancestry.
Ancestry corrected several misspelled place names, such as "Mount Gambier".
A subjourney that was missing a name now shows one.
